description: This file defines a Kivy UI widget called Splitter, which allows resizing of its child widget via dragging or double-tapping. It includes class definitions for Splitter and SplitterStrip, with properties, event handling, and example usage.

classes.name: SplitterStrip
classes.description: A Button subclass used for the graphical representation of the splitter boundary.

classes.name: Splitter
classes.description: A BoxLayout subclass that provides a resizable widget with draggable boundary and customizable appearance.

methods.name: on_sizable_from
methods.description: Adjusts the splitter's boundary strip widget based on the 'sizable_from' property.

methods.name: add_widget
methods.description: Adds a child widget to the splitter, ensuring only one child is accepted.

methods.name: remove_widget
methods.description: Removes a child widget from the splitter.

methods.name: strip_down
methods.description: Handles the start of a drag operation when the boundary strip is touched.

methods.name: on_press
methods.description: Event dispatched when the splitter boundary is pressed.

methods.name: _rebind_parent
methods.description: Rebinds size change events to the parent widget.

methods.name: rescale_parent_proportion
methods.description: Adjusts the splitter size proportionally when the parent is resized.

methods.name: _do_size
methods.description: Ensures the splitter size stays within min and max bounds.

methods.name: _is_moving
methods.description: Determines if the boundary is moving based on touch movement.

methods.name: strip_move
methods.description: Handles dragging of the boundary strip to resize the widget.

methods.name: strip_up
methods.description: Handles the end of a drag or double-tap event on the boundary strip.

methods.name: on_release
methods.description: Event dispatched when the splitter boundary is released.
